decisions.reason: Optical spectrum connectivity uses the firm's owned fibre, was moved up to the home page in 2019, and fits the move toward high-bandwidth infrastructure, so this option shows rising value and costs little to keep.

The voice number ordering portal is a low-cost software add-on that supports the existing voice business and was still mentioned in 2019, so keeping it open costs little even though voice is declining and related voice products were already dropped.
